description: A bearded prospector in a worn wide-brim hat and patched leather clothes kneels by a pale rock ledge, striking it with a pick hammer. A laden pack mule stands behind him. The setting is a dry desert with agave plants, prickly pear and ocotillo, and mesas in the distance. A lever-action rifle leans against the rock on the right, and white rock chips lie on the ground. The painting fills the frame with no visible text.
